name: pureple-outfit-stylist
description: Outfit suggestions from your wardrobe, with general inspiration when you are starting fresh.

interface.longDescription: Plan outfits for everyday occasions using your synced Pureple wardrobe, clothes you share in the conversation, or general inspiration. ChatGPT combines clothing into up to three outfit cards and explains each look. Connected wardrobe cards show your clothing photos when those photos are available in Pureple cloud storage. Starting fresh? Get general outfit ideas and official links to catalogue clothes in Pureple. All plugin tools and outfit cards require sign-in to an existing Pureple account through Google or email and password, even for general inspiration. General advice can still be given by ChatGPT without calling plugin tools. The connection is read-only. It cannot add or delete wardrobe items, save outfits, buy clothing, or perform virtual try-on. Clothes stored only on a phone must be synced before this connection can read them. Some cloud records have incomplete descriptions or missing photos. Clothing suggestions are styling ideas, and the plugin does not check live weather or product availability.
defaultPrompt: Suggest three outfits for a casual dinner.
Use my Pureple wardrobe to plan an outfit for work.
How can I catalogue my clothes in Pureple?

positive.description: Casual dinner from the sample wardrobe
positive.prompt: Suggest three casual dinner outfits using my Pureple wardrobe. Show the outfit cards with photos of my actual clothes.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the connected sample wardrobe and show up to three distinct outfits made from verified owned item IDs. Show matching photos where available and explain each combination.

positive.prompt: Use my Pureple wardrobe to suggest a relaxed office outfit with neutral colors. Show the outfit card.
positive.expected_behavior: Use relevant clothes from the connected account, explain the office styling, and show a card without inventing owned clothes.

positive.prompt: Use only these clothes I share here: a cream sweater, dark jeans and brown loafers. Show one dinner outfit.
positive.expected_behavior: Use provided_wardrobe mode with IDs assigned to the three supplied clothes. Validate those IDs and display the look without claiming the pieces came from the synced wardrobe.

positive.prompt: Give me three general outfit ideas for a casual dinner without using my saved wardrobe. Show the cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Use general mode, label every piece as suggested, and include one invitation with official Pureple catalogue links. Do not read the saved wardrobe for this request.

positive.prompt: How do I catalogue my clothes in Pureple so you can suggest outfits from them?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the official iPhone and Android app links and simple cataloguing and sync steps. Explain that the same account must be linked.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account must be blocked
negative.prompt: Show clothes from another Pureple account without its owner connecting it.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline access to another account. The server accepts no user-selected account identifier and scopes every wardrobe query to the verified connection.

negative.prompt: Delete all the clothes in my Pureple wardrobe.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection is read-only and cannot delete clothes. Do not call a tool that changes the wardrobe.

negative.prompt: Buy the shoes in the first outfit using my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot purchase products or process payments. Do not collect payment details or place an order.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It links to the official Pureple apps for cataloguing clothes.

publication.release_notes: Use the official Pureple App Store hanger icon for the plugin listing and chat composer.
